name: Mini portable multipurpose travel iron
description:
Product Details of Portable Electric Steamer / Hair Straightener

Color: Dark Green (As Given Pictures)

Power: 30W

Rated Voltage: 220V

Cord Length: 1.45 meters

Water Tank Capacity: 60ml

Material: PC, PBT, Titanium Plate

Heating Temperature: 302°F / 150℃

Heating Mode: Electric Heating

Portability: Compact and lightweight, easily carried in a suitcase

Description:
This portable electric steamer or hair straightener combines compact design with efficient performance. Lightweight and travel-friendly, it is easy to carry in a suitcase while providing consistent heat for styling. Perfect for home use or on-the-go grooming.
